message: no device in this circuit contributes any noise, so the spectrum would be identically zero
description: A device is only a noise source if it says so: a resistor and the reference diode contribute thermal and shot noise, and a compiled Verilog-A model contributes exactly what its own `white_noise()`, `flicker_noise()` and `noise_table()` calls declare. A model with none is silent by construction.
actions: Add noise sources to the models, or check that the circuit holds the devices you expect.
